Specials support, One Piece Fan Letter, selectable poster sets, a third metadata
source — plus a run of fixes for things that were failing silently.

## Added

- **Specials support.** The One Pace **Specials** arc (dataset arc part 0) is no
  longer skipped. It flows through coverage, metadata reconciliation and Full
  Plex sync like any other season, landing in Plex's native Season 0.
- **"One Piece Fan Letter" now downloads.** Its feed title isn't an arc name, so
  it could never be placed by title, and its re-cuts ship CRC32s the dataset can
  lag on indefinitely. It's now pinned to **Specials S00E98** — the slot where the
  catalog already holds its title and description — so it downloads and inherits
  that metadata.
- **Poster sets** (`POSTER_SET`) — five collections: SpykerNZ and its alternate
  show design, plus piratezekk, mizzoufan523 and Official. **Every set is
  uploaded to Plex**, so Plex's own poster picker lists them all and you can
  switch there too; the set you choose is uploaded last, which is what makes it
  the selected one. The Settings picker previews each set's real art.
- **OnePacerr API as a third metadata source** (`USE_ONEPACERR`). It tracks the
  same feed and sheets we do, but continuously, so it often knows a release
  before the dataset regenerates. Consulted **only after** our own sources come up
  empty, and every failure is swallowed — a gap-filler, never a dependency.
- **Per-arc filtering** (`ARC_INCLUDE` / `ARC_EXCLUDE`). Comma-separated arc
  parts or titles; a filtered-out arc isn't tracked anywhere. Set
  `ARC_EXCLUDE=Specials` if you'd rather not see the specials counted as missing.
- **Show genres and summary now come from the dataset** rather than hardcoded
  constants, and the show gets a **summary** for the first time.
- **Re-apply posters** button, **`PLEX_SHOW_TITLE`** for libraries where the show
  is named differently, and the feed's publication date is now kept and used as
  an air date for episodes the catalog doesn't list yet.

## Fixed

- **A newer-than-the-catalog file was offered as an "upgrade" — which would have
  downgraded it.** A CRC32 mismatch is only out-of-date when the on-disk release
  is one the catalog knows; an unknown one is *newer*. Those now report as
  "present (not in catalog yet)".
- **A poster that never actually took was skipped forever.** Poster sync trusted
  its own records, so once an ETag was stored it kept getting a `304` and moving
  on while Plex showed no art. It now checks Plex's real state and re-uploads.
- **A brand-new season could end up with no poster** — the season lookup ran
  before Plex's scan had created it, and failed *silently*. It now polls, and says
  so when it gives up.
- **Blown-out / faded thumbnails are now detected.** Blank-frame detection only
  caught flat single-colour stills, so a fade-to-white flash with a silhouette in
  it passed as a real frame.
- **The thumbnail diagnostic was unreachable** — verdicts are cached per detector
  version, and the one control that clears that cache was hidden unless something
  was already flagged.
- **A release whose CRC32 isn't catalogued yet no longer dead-ends**; it falls
  through to the provisional path, and stays retryable rather than being dropped.

## Removed

- **Reset cast** action and button. Cast sync went away in 1.1.9, so nothing can
  create the bare actor tags it cleaned up.

## Docker

```
docker pull ghcr.io/dyonng/one-pace-plex-automator:1.1.27
```
